card.fires_on: Partway through rare or foreign proper names and Latin plant names, where a word is split into pieces, mostly in environmental or forestry text. Also fires on a few linking words in phrases like 'Reducing Emissions from Deforestation'.

modes.description: A word inside a fixed environmental program or cost phrase.
